| `REQ-001` | AT-01: Launching the human interface shows only reading/exploration destinations and loads no draft, review, publish, inference, query-console, AI-generation, or other authoring modules or controls, including hidden Advanced modes., The project name and global search remain visible; navigation collapses on smaller screens; theme/help remain secondary controls; raw storage kinds, build actions, readiness matrices, proposal counters, and maintenance actions do not become the reader's main navigation. | `active` | 0 | None |

| `REQ-003` | AT-08: An exact-ID lookup of a deprecated entry retains its historical definition, status, and recorded replacement link rather than rewriting history., AT-09: A draft or inferred record exposed through an explicit permitted filter remains visibly distinct from approved asserted knowledge. | `REQ-004` | Starting points come from reviewed presentation configuration or a deterministic explicit project record; node degree does not manufacture a hierarchy.
